howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会按模板产出 10 页投资人融资 deck:白底加蓝紫渐变封面,依次包含 Problem、Solution、Why Now、市场规模、traction 柱状图、商业模式、团队与 Ask 等页面。
howto.when: 当你提到 pitch、投资人 deck、融资等关键词,或要求做 seed/VC 轮演示文稿时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一份 10 页种子轮融资 deck

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude produces a 10-page investor fundraising deck from the template: white background with a blue-purple gradient cover, covering Problem, Solution, Why Now, market size, a traction bar chart, business model, team and the Ask page.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention pitch, investor deck or fundraising, or ask for a seed/VC round presentation.
